subject: MedicoSys assurance: admin activity export contract-level deliverables
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medicosys.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-12-01T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Request — admin activity export shape and delivery options

Hi Tessa,

As part of our SIG/SOC2 evidence collection for the MedicoSys onboarding, we need a clear description of the admin activity logging dataset you can provide on-demand and on a scheduled basis. Specifically we need answers to:

- Exact event types captured (operator login, API key creation/use, role changes, token issuance, model deploy/rollback, snapshots of access lists, data plane access attempts)
- Event fields/schema (timestamp w/ timezone, actor id/email, internal user id, session id, request id, affected resource, action, before/after where applicable)
- Retention default and options for longer windows; retention guarantees for Dedicated/Private customers
- Export formats supported (ndjson, CSV, Parquet), compression options, and whether you include signed manifests (HMAC/SHA256)
- Transport options: cross-account S3 push, presigned URLs, SFTP, or encrypted container handoff.
- Time to produce a 90-day export on-demand and whether exports are incremental/delta-capable
- Redaction options for PII and how you indicate redacted fields in the manifest

We also want a small sample (<=500 events) with a manifest so our audit team can validate parsing. Can you send that and the above detail by COB Friday?

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Head of Security, MedicoSys
security@medicosys.com

--
Attachment: none

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medicosys.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-12-01T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request — admin activity export shape and delivery options

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below and I attached a 250-event sample + a manifest stub for your parsing checks. Grace and Karthik are looped for retention/transport questions.

Quick summary (details follow):
- Events: operator_auth, api_key_event, role_change, model_deploy, model_rollback, snapshot_change, data_plane_access_fail, privileged_action
- Schema: timestamp (ISO8601 UTC), actor_email, actor_internal_id, session_id, request_id, resource_type, resource_id, action, success_bool, before_state (nullable), after_state (nullable), region, tenant_id
- Retention: hosted default 90 days; Dedicated customers can opt for 1y/3y legal hold with export pricing; Private deployments depend on customer storage config
- Formats: ndjson (preferred), gzipped; Parquet for bulk analytics; CSV export with quoted fields on request
- Transport: we support cross-account S3 push (recommended), presigned S3 GET for onetime downloads, and SFTP for legacy partners. All deliveries are encrypted-in-transit; payloads are encrypted at rest using customer-managed KMS if requested
- Manifest: we produce a SHA256 HMAC-signed manifest with file checksums and schema version; manifest includes sample redaction markers ("<REDACTED>") and a redaction map
- SLA: standard on-demand 48–72 hours for 90-day pulls; can commit to 24–48 hours for enterprise contracts. Incremental exports: yes — delta cursors available for repeated pulls

Attachments: sample_admin_events.ndjson.gz, admin_activity_manifest_v1.json (manifest includes field list and redaction map).

Questions for you:
1) Do you require cross-account role assumption for S3 push or will presigned URLs suffice?
2) Is an HMAC manifest sufficient or do you require signed attestations (e.g., PKI signature)?
3) Any required timezone normalization beyond UTC (e.g., include local offset)?

We'll follow up with detailed retention options and a runbook for export verification.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192

--
Attachments: sample_admin_events.ndjson.gz (250 events), admin_activity_manifest_v1.json

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medicosys.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@medicosys.com
Date: 2025-12-02T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request — admin activity export shape and delivery options

Thanks Tessa — sample looks good. A few clarifications from our audit team:

- We prefer cross-account S3 push using an IAM role (security@medicosys will provide an ARN). Presigned links are acceptable for ad-hoc downloads but not for our automated ingest.
- Manifest: SHA256 HMAC is OK but we need a process to verify the HMAC key exchange. If possible, supply a PKI-signed manifest for the first delivery and HMAC thereafter.
- Timezone: normalize timestamps to UTC and include an explicit tz field in the schema (tz: "UTC").
- We require actor identifiers to include both email and an internal immutable user id (not ephemeral session ids).
- Redaction: indicate redacted fields with the literal "<REDACTED>" and include redaction_reason in the manifest when applied.

Can you confirm you can accept our role ARN and a 48-hour SLA for one-off 90-day pulls? If yes, please provide a short delivery checklist so our engineer can sign the role and test a small push.

Regards,
Jordan

--
Attachment: none

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medicosys.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-12-08T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request — admin activity export shape and delivery options

On Mon, Dec 1, 2025 at 10:05 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jordan — thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below and I attached a 250-event sample + a manifest stub for your parsing checks. Grace and Karthik are looped for retention/transport questions.

Jordan — confirming next steps and capacities.

What we will deliver (contract-level statement):
- Export shape: NDJSON gzipped files, schema v1.2 (timestamp in ISO8601 UTC + tz field, actor_email, actor_internal_id, session_id, request_id, resource_type, resource_id, action, success_bool, before_state, after_state, redaction_reason)
- Manifest: PKI-signed on first delivery (PDF signature + detached PKCS7), then SHA256 HMAC for subsequent deliveries. HMAC key exchange: we support KMS-wrapped key exchange or one-time secure paste via our secure portal.
- Transport: cross-account S3 push using provided ARN (preferred) — fallback: presigned GET URL for ad-hoc pulls. SFTP available but not recommended for large volumes.
- Retention & SLA: Hosted default retention 90 days; for Redwood Dedicated we can offer 1y retention with legal-hold export pricing. On-demand 90-day export SLA: 48 hours for enterprise plan (we can commit this in SOW).
- Redaction: redacted fields set to "<REDACTED>" and enumerated in manifest with redaction_reason. We do not modify request_id or request-level identifiers when redacting.

Action items:
- Karthik: validate HMAC toolchain & confirm we can produce PKI-signed initial manifest (INF-3121).
- Grace: prepare export job and schedule a one-time test push to MedicoSys staging ARN when they provide it.
- Jordan: please send the role ARN and a contact for ingestion verification; confirm acceptance of the 48-hour SLA for the requested 90-day pull so we can commit dates.

Related links: INF-3121 (implementation ticket), export schema doc (drive link).

Thanks — I'll follow up once Karthik confirms the signing details.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192

--
Attachments included: admin_activity_manifest_v1.json (manifest example), sample_admin_events.ndjson.gz (250 events)
